title: Watchlist recipe
description: The `recipe` of a `custom` or `browser` watchlist row. The row's source picks the definition: $defs.custom (fetch/custom.py) or $defs.browser (fetch/browser.py). Every key either executor reads is declared, and no other key is accepted, so a misspelled key is rejected when the row is added and again by the worker before fetch. Validated by apps/web/src/lib/recipe-schema.ts (web add, /api/v1/watchlist, MCP add_source) and apps/worker/ats_worker/fetch/recipe_schema.py (worker, config seed, onboard-board add_watched.py).

custom.title: custom recipe (plain HTTP)
custom.description: One HTTP request per page. The JSON payload (or the __NEXT_DATA__ blob of an HTML page) is walked with dotted paths: keys index objects, integer segments index lists ("office.0.name").

url.description: List endpoint. Must be a public http(s) URL (checked again at fetch).

mode.description: json (default): the response is JSON. next-data: extract <script id=__NEXT_DATA__> from an HTML response, then treat it as JSON.

headers.description: Request headers. A browser User-Agent is added when absent.

body.description: POST JSON body. page.body_param is written into it per page.

item_path.description: Dotted path to the job array. Omit when the payload itself is the array.

total_path.description: Dotted path to the total row count; stops offset pagination early.

page.description: Pagination. Stops on an empty page or a page of already-seen ids.

type.description: offset: advance by rows; page: advance a page number; none (default): one request.

param.description: Query parameter carrying the offset/page number.

body_param.description: body key carrying the offset/page number (POST boards).

size_param.description: Query parameter carrying the page size.

fields.description: Raw job object -> canonical posting. Each value is a dotted path.

location.description: A list value is joined with ", ".

url.description: Dotted path, or a template whose {dotted.path} placeholders are filled from the raw item.

description.description: A list of paths is concatenated. HTML is flattened to text.

posted_at.description: ISO date, "Month D, YYYY", or epoch s/ms.

external_id.description: Dedup key; a row without one is dropped.

detail.description: Optional per-posting hydration for a board whose list call carries only a teaser.

url.description: Template with {dotted.path} placeholders filled from the RAW list item.

url_field.description: Instead of url: a canonical posting key holding the detail URL (usually job_url).

mode.description: http-json (default): read fields with dotted paths; http-html: read them with CSS selectors.

browser.title: browser recipe (headless Chromium)
browser.description: The listing is rendered in Chromium and each job card is read from the rendered DOM with CSS selectors.

url.description: Listing page (page 1). Relative card URLs resolve against it.

mode.description: Optional label; the only browser mode.

item.description: CSS selector matching one node per job card.

type.description: url: render template.format(n) for n = start, start+1, ... until a page adds nothing new; none (default): page 1 only.

fields.description: Card node -> canonical posting. title, location, url, description, posted_at and external_id feed the posting; any other name is a helper a url template can reference.

url.description: A CSS spec, or a string containing { = a template over this recipe's other field values.

detail.description: Optional per-posting hydration from each posting's detail page.

url_field.description: Canonical posting key holding the detail URL (usually job_url). Without it there is no hydration.

mode.description: Omit to render each detail page in Chromium. http-html/http-json hydrate over plain HTTP (Chromium only enumerates).

cssSpec.description: A CSS selector string (the element's text), or {selector?, attr?, extract?}: pick a child by selector (default: the card itself), read attr (default: its text), then keep regex group 1 of extract.

selector.description: null or absent: the card itself.

detailFields.description: Detail document -> posting keys. A non-empty value overwrites the list call's. Read with dotted paths on a JSON document, with CSS specs on an HTML one.
